# Outreach — Study in Malta

> Outreach helps international students compare English-language and higher-education programmes in Malta, understand indicative fees and requirements, prepare application documents, and book a free consultation. Institution admissions and visa decisions are made by the relevant institution and Maltese authorities.

## Primary public pages

- [Study in Malta: courses, fees and free consultation](https://consultation.outreachstudy.eu/): Main application and guidance page.
- [Programme, fee and visa guide](https://consultation.outreachstudy.eu/onlinesessions): Detailed programme catalogue, English courses, partner institutions, application journey and visa guidance.
- [Full machine-readable Study in Malta guide](https://consultation.outreachstudy.eu/study-in-malta.md): Consolidated facts, programme listings, prices, documents and FAQs.

## Main topics

- English courses in Malta and online
- Diploma, bachelor's and master's programmes
- Business, accountancy, IT, health and social care, tourism, hospitality and logistics
- Tuition fees, duration, qualification level and entry guidance
- Malta student application and visa-document preparation
- Free programme consultation and candidate dashboard

## Education providers shown

- EIE European Business School
- GBS Malta
- English Path Malta
- London School of Commerce Malta
- Kensington English
- School of Business & Management Malta

## Official resources

- [Malta student national visa document checklist](https://identita.gov.mt/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/03a.-List-of-Required-Documents-Student_National_Visa.pdf)
- [XML sitemap](https://consultation.outreachstudy.eu/sitemap.xml)

## Usage notes

- Fees, scholarships, entry requirements, intakes and availability are guidance and must be reconfirmed before enrolment.
- Private dashboard, login, admin and personalized session URLs are not public knowledge sources and should not be indexed.
